summary: Black Titan Corporation, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice and proxy statement for its 2026 Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting to be held virtually on November 16, 2026. The meeting's first proposal seeks shareholder approval for an 11:1 consolidation of the company's ordinary shares, alongside a related change in authorized share capital. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation on a deal is disclosed; this is a routine meeting notice and proxy circular, mapped to a US annual/EGM proxy equivalent.
